payload.title: Loading data into Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates how to load various types of paleoclimate data into the Pyleoclim library for analysis. It covers loading data from pre-loaded datasets, LiPD files, NetCDF files, CSV files, NOAA text files, and PANGAEA datasets. The notebook utilizes several Python libraries to handle different data formats and convert them into Pyleoclim Series objects for further analysis and visualization.
goals: Showcase handling of different data formats
Convert data into Pyleoclim Series objects
